data.action: 趴在窗台上看雨滴滑落
data.description: 【澄闪 · 雨窗】雨声淅沥的午后，苏茜双手托腮趴在理发店的玻璃窗台前，出神地看着雨滴顺着明亮的玻璃滑落。她头顶的小猫耳随着雨声轻轻转动——「下雨天的时候店里总是很安静呢……博士，要不要我帮你做一次免费的头部精油按摩放松一下？」
data.promptProse: Goldenglow leans on the barbershop's broad windowsill with chin in both hands, watching rain streak the pane as pink ears twitch and her fluffy tail sways. White shirt, yellow ascot and dark pinafore retain her styling outfit, tool pouch nearby. The medium close-up includes the glass and shop interior behind. Soft grey rain light illuminates her thoughtful face and droplets, while warm shop light catches the back of her hair and sill edges.
data.title: 澄闪 · 雨窗
